bundle.text:
- insert:
    # agent-presets 服务：官方 preset 根由 dsh composeProfile 自动补入；
    # includeUserRoot 默认 true，因此也会读取 ~/.dsh/.agent-presets 下的用户自定义 preset。
    - id: agent-presets
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets'
      config:
        default: standard

    # minitui 自身
    - id: minitui
      name: '@dsh-external/dsh-minitui'
      config: {}

[](#)
[](README.en.md)

这是一个为 `Deepseek Harness`(`dsh`) 设计的 `TUI` 前端，和目前主流的 `dsh-TUI` 项目相比，这个项目会更加*简陋*。因为本人仅仅是个人开发者，没有团队，所以功能不是很复杂，界面也不是很华丽。这个项目是本人做的第一个 `TypeScript` 项目，整体框架由人工编写，有些功能实在写不出来，让 AI 帮忙实现。

需要注意的是，开发环境是 `Ubuntu 22.04`，且使用了 `neo-blessed` 第三方库，可能在 `Windows` 上的适配可能会有未知 bug 。`Windows` 用户请使用 `WSL2` (感觉绝大多数使用 `dsh` 的 `Windows` 用户都会用 `WSL` 吧)。

本项目和 `dsh-TUI` 最大的不同我认为就是在于*简陋*，或者好听点说，*简洁*。它是为**代码工作者**(尤其是后端)设计的。我的设计理念是 `TUI` 就应该是简洁的、以键盘交互为主的。因此本项目的界面里没有任何供鼠标点击的地方，只有纯粹的和 Agent 交互的输入框。这样可以规避每次启动 `dsh` 时打开 Web 界面再选择工作区的步骤，直接可以在项目目录打开 `TUI` 界面与 Agent 交互。

另外，本项目的界面参考了 `OpenCode` 的界面。很干净，没有艺术字，没有鲸鱼娘，只有输入框、对话框和一个监控区。

目前的功能就只有和 Agent 的对话，短期内可能会在左侧的监控区做一点文章，也希望各位开发者能提出需要的功能。但是我不打算做太复杂或者花里胡哨的功能，毕竟相比于 `dsh-TUI` 项目，我这个项目实在是蚍蜉撼树。如果是对于代码工作者很有用的功能，我一定会尽量加入。

#### 输入区快捷键

| 功能 | 快捷键 |
  | ----- | ----- |
  | 发送 | Alt+Enter |
  | 换行 | Enter |
  | 补全 | Tab |
  | 复制 | Ctrl+Shift+C |
  | 粘贴 | Ctrl+Shift+V |
  | 退出 | Ctrl+C |

这里设计成发送需要按下 `Alt+Enter` 才能触发，因为在与 Agent的交流中，使用 *Markdown* 格式效率更高，但是大多数和 AI 交流的场景按下 `Enter` 键都会直接发送，导致用户无法输入完整且清晰的 *Markdown* 语句。因此在这个 `TUI` 界面里，`Enter` 仅用于换行，不会用于发送消息。

#### 输入区命令

除了 `dsh` 中原本的命令外，本项目还引入了一些其他的命令来实现一些功能。

- `/session`

本项目为了应对不使用点击切换会话的情况，新增了一个 `/session` 命令用于切换**同一个工作区目录下**的会话或者创建会话。

千万注意：无法切换到当前工作区以外的会话，这需要你先退出 `TUI` 界面，切换到你需要的目录，再打开 `TUI` 界面。

- `/model`

虽然 `dsh` 的 Web 端本身也有这个命令，但是不同的前端仍然需要重新实现，实际流程可能不同，因此在这里指出。

本项目的 `/model` 命令用于切换模型和推理等级。需要注意的是，目前只支持 Deepseek 本家的模型，不支持外接的其他模型。

#### 自定义

本项目其实没有提供多少自定义功能，只有一些颜色和创建会话时的默认配置。第一次运行插件后，会在插件的根目录下生成一个 `userconfig.json` 文件。看变量名称你也能看懂是什么意思(毕竟 `json` 格式不支持写注释)。如果填写了不存在的值会导致插件打不开哦。

本项目暂时还没有开源到 `npm` 仓库的想法，所以暂时只能通过 GitHub 仓库获取源码自己用 `tsc` 编译。整体的过程如下：

```bash
  git clone https://github.com/AncientMoon114/dsh-minitui
  cd ./dsh-minitui-0.1.0/
  npm install
  npx tsc

然后就可以在项目目录里通过以下命令打开 `TUI` 界面：

```bash
  dsh --profile minitui
  ```

如果您嫌弃这样调用太麻烦，我的建议是修改 `~/.bashrc` ，添加缩写：

```
  alias dsh-minitui='dsh --profile minitui'
  ```

如果遇到什么问题，可以在 `Issue` 界面提出。本人开发自理尚浅，如果给您带来了糟糕的体验，还请理性批评。

本项目使用了一些第三方库来实现前端的渲染，包括 `neo-blessed` 、`marked` 、`marked-terminal`和 `streammark` 等。

之所以在这里指出这一点，是因为我在实现过程中发现 `streammark` 在渲染时会导致代码块的边界显示异常，因此我手动修改了这个第三方库来实现更美观的显示效果。我已经通过 `patch-package` 工具打上了补丁，所以用户在安装依赖时是可以正常安装的，但是在之后的更新或者用户的全局环境变量中可能会有冲突，在这里指出这种可能性。

This is a `TUI` front-end project designed for `Deepseek Harness`(`dsh`). Compared to main-stream `TUI` project, `dsh-TUI`, this project is much more simple, because I am a individual developer without team support. Thus, the function of this project is not complicated like other mature pojects. Bsesides, this is the first `TypeScript` project I've worked on. The main frame is written by human while some functions are too complicated for me so that I called AI for help. So, it is definitely a AI assisted project.
Pay attention that the developing platform is `Ubuntu 22.04` and I use `neo-blessed` which might cause bug on `Windows`. After all, most of Windows developers of `dsh` need to use `WSL2` for sure.

The biggest different between this project and `dsh-TUI` is *clear*. This project is designed for **coders**, especially after-end coders. I think `TUI` surfaces should be clear and mainly interact with users by keyboard. So there is nowhere for users to click in this project. All works can be down with keyboard.

Besides, the user interface refers to `OpenCode`, which is clean without artificial fonts or desktop pets. There are only input box, chat box and a control panel.

Current function incudes only communicating with Agent. I might add more functions to control panel as long as they are convenient for coders. However, I would never add slick (in bad meaning) functions to it.

#### Shortcut key in input box

| Function | Shorcut key |
  | ----- | ----- |
  | Send | Alt+Enter |
  | Return | Enter |
  | Complete | Tab |
  | Copy | Ctrl+Shift+C |
  | Paste | Ctrl+Shift+V |
  | Exit | Ctrl+C |

It is specially designed that user needs to press `Alt+Enter` to send, because using *Markdown* is more efficient than plain text in communication with AI Agent while most applications prevent users to type return in the input area.

#### Commands in input box

Apart with commands in web UI of `dsh`, this project adds more commands to do some jobs done by mouse in web UI.

- `/session`

To solve the problem of changing or creating sessions without clicking, the project adds a new `/session` command to create new session or change session **in the same workspace directory you've opened miniTUI**.

It is warned that you cannot change to sessions outside current workspace. This behavior needs you to exit `TUI`, change your directory to new workplace and open `TUI` again.

- `/model`

Although `/model` is an existed command in web UI, but different UI needs to re-realize this function, so I need to mention it here.

The `/model` command of this project is used to change model and reasoning effort. It is reminded that it only supports *Deepseek Models*, including `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`. Other models like Claude or ChatGPT are not supported.

#### Self customize

Actually, there aren't much things to customize. Several colors and tolarent agent config of sessions when you create them can be customize in `userconfig.json`. This file will be automatically created when you run the `miniTUI` plugin at first time. You can understand what the config choice meanings through their name.

It is unfortunate that currently this project is not intended to emit to `npm`. So the only way to use is to get source code from GitHub and compile it yourself. Operations like below:

```bash
  git clone https://github.com/AncientMoon114/dsh-minitui
  cd ./dsh-minitui-0.1.0/
  npm install
  npx tsc

Then you can open `TUI` in your project workspace like this:

```bash
  dsh --profile minitui
  ```

If this is too fussy for you, I recommend you to add abbreviation in `~/.bashrc`:

```
  alias dsh-minitui='dsh --profile minitui'
  ```

If you meet any problem, please raise it in `Issue` part. I have to explain that I am a green-hand in coding. If this project brings you horrible experience, please critic me rationally.

This project uses several third-party libs to render the front-end interface, including `neo-blessed`, `marked`, `marked-terminal` and `streammark`.

I have to point it out that I have altered `streammark` lib because it causes bug in rendering the corner of code blocks. I added patch through `patch-package` tool so that it can work well when user installs it. However, if you have `streammark` lib in your global environment it may cause crack.
